import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
di1,do1=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
di2,do2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']

def transform(g):
    sep=None
    for c in range(3,10):
        if any(all(x==c for x in r) for r in g) and any(all(r[j]==c for r in g) for j in range(len(g[0]))):
            sep=c;break
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==sep for x in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(r[j]==sep for r in g)]
    def segs(idx,n):
        s=[];st=0
        for i in list(idx)+[n]:
            if st<i:s.append((st,i))
            st=i+1
        return s
    R,C=segs(rows,len(g)),segs(cols,len(g[0]))
    from collections import Counter
    cnter=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    maj=cnter.most_common(1)[0][0]
    minority=[c for c in cnter if c not in (sep,maj)]
    # minority = the non-separator color that is less frequent
    mins=sorted(minority,key=lambda c:cnter[c])[0] if minority else maj
    counts=[[sum(1 for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1) if g[i][j]==mins) for c0,c1 in C] for r0,r1 in R]
    mx=max(max(r) for r in counts)
    return [[1 if v==mx else maj for v in r] for r in counts]

print(transform(di1),do1)
print(transform(di2),do2)
import json
print(json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))
